_comment: Ground truth list curated from documented OWASP Juice Shop and DVWA vulnerability challenges. is_vulnerable=true are verified exploitable lab flaws; is_vulnerable=false are scanner false positives / non-exploitable endpoints; edge cases document realistic inconclusive outcomes.
